meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取图片内容并转成文字
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让电脑自动读出图片里的文字和信息
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into text that AI can understand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to understand images

howto.what: 装上后,当对话里出现图片文件路径、网址或图片占位符,而 Claude 无法直接看到图片时,它会自动调用 modlens 把图片转成文字版结构化证据,再据此回答。
howto.when: 当对话中出现带 .png、.jpg 等扩展名的图片路径/URL,或 [Image #1] 等占位符,且你看不到图片内容时触发;用户询问安装/配置 modlens 提供商时也会用到。

say.note: modlens 会转录图中文字并输出结构化证据。

say.text: 帮我把 modlens 的提供商换成 Gemini。

howto.what_en: When enabled, if an image path/URL or placeholder appears and Claude cannot see the image, it runs modlens to convert it into structured JSON evidence (text transcription, layout, semantics) and answers from that data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a conversation contains an image path/URL with an image extension or a placeholder like [Image #1] and the model cannot view the image; also when the user asks to install/configure modlens providers.

say_en.note: modlens will transcribe text and output structured evidence.

say_en.text: What’s in the image at this URL? https://example.com/a.jpg
